item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02655","case1_error":"Evaluates 18 months plus 6 years as 8.5 years instead of 7.5 years.","case2_error":"Subtracts the overlap from both spray totals, excluding germs killed by both from the total killed.","reason":"Case 1 miscalculates a correctly written expression; case 2 uses an incorrect union relation that removes the overlap twice.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02656","case1_error":"Omits guns, divides supplies between bases instead of three categories, falsely equates base totals, and introduces arithmetic errors.","case2_error":"No clear error: interprets the ambiguous phrase 'twice more' as twice as many, yielding 2400 total turtles.","reason":"Case 1 has explicit modeling errors. Case 2 follows a plausible interpretation of ambiguous wording; the reference cannot establish a unique intended multiplier.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02657","case1_error":"Subtracts only Ryan's quarter of the marbles, omitting Chris's withdrawal.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written sum 8 + 12 + 16 + 4 as 30 instead of 40.","reason":"Case 1 omits a required withdrawal from its calculation; case 2 includes all required terms but evaluates their sum incorrectly.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02658","case1_error":"Calculates the cost for one company's ten ads and reports it as the three-company total.","case2_error":"Calculates this month's raised earnings and reports them as the two-month total, omitting last month's earnings.","reason":"Both report one component's correctly calculated amount as the requested aggregate, omitting the other required components.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02659","case1_error":"Uses two houses for Zion and two friends, omitting Zion's house from the combined area.","case2_error":"Replaces Friday's 40% increase with an unsupported 15% increase applied across five days.","reason":"Case 1 omits one participant from the aggregate; case 2 changes both the specified percentage and the number of days receiving the increase.","judgment":"different"}]}
